fields.regle: if + présent → will : possible. if + prétérit → would : imaginaire ou peu probable.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Si tu pars maintenant, tu attraperas ton train. »

accepted: If you leave now, you'll catch your train
If you leave now, you will catch your train

hints: Éventualité réelle : if + présent, puis will.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Si je gagnais au loto, j'ouvrirais une librairie. »

accepted: If I won the lottery, I would open a bookshop
If I won the lottery, I'd open a bookshop

hints: Hypothèse improbable : if + prétérit, puis would.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Qu'est-ce que tu ferais si on te proposait ce poste ? »

accepted: What would you do if they offered you that job

hints: Question hypothétique : would dans la principale.

exercises.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic. (rain)

accepted: rains

hints: Après if, jamais will : présent simple.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ more space, I would buy a piano. (have)

accepted: had

hints: Situation contraire à la réalité : prétérit après if.

exercises.source: I don't have a car, so I take the bus.

accepted: If I had a car, I wouldn't take the bus
If I had a car, I would not take the bus

hints: La réalité s'inverse : prétérit après if, would ensuite.

exercises.source: If you will need help, call me.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: If you need help, call me

hints: Après if, on n'emploie pas will.

exercises.prompt: If she ___ earlier, she would sleep better.

accepted: went to bed

hints: La principale est en would : la condition passe au prétérit.

fields.regle: if + présent → will : la condition est ouverte. if + prétérit → would : elle est improbable ou irréelle.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Si tu demandes, ils diront oui.

accepted: If you ask, they will say yes

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Si j'avais son numéro, je l'appellerais.

accepted: What would you do in my position

accepted: complains

accepted: were
was

hints: Irréel : were à toutes les personnes.

exercises.prompt: I do not have the budget, so I cannot hire.

accepted: If I had the budget, I would hire

exercises.source: I do not have the budget, so I cannot hire.
hints: Irréel du présent.

exercises.prompt: If it will rain, the fiesta is cancelled.

accepted: If it rains, the fiesta is cancelled

exercises.source: If it will rain, the fiesta is cancelled.
hints: Jamais de will après if.

exercises.prompt: If they ___ more time, the pilot would work.

accepted: had

hints: Irréel du présent.

fields.regle: I wish + prétérit : regret sur le présent. Avec be, were à toutes les personnes.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « J'aimerais parler mieux allemand. »

accepted: I wish I spoke better German

hints: Regret sur le présent : wish + prétérit.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Si seulement j'étais plus grande. »

accepted: I wish I were taller
If only I were taller

hints: Avec be, l'irréel emploie were, même au singulier.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Je regrette de ne pas avoir de jardin. »

accepted: I wish I had a garden

hints: La phrase française négative devient positive en anglais.

exercises.prompt: I wish this room ___ a window. (have)

accepted: had

hints: Regret sur une situation actuelle : prétérit.

exercises.prompt: If only he ___ so loudly. (not / talk)

accepted: didn't talk
did not talk

hints: if only fonctionne comme I wish.

exercises.source: I can't drive, and it's a problem.
exercises.prompt: Exprime le regret, en commençant par « I wish ».

accepted: I wish I could drive

hints: can devient could après wish.

exercises.source: I wish I have more free time.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I wish I had more free time

hints: Après wish, le présent devient prétérit.

exercises.prompt: I wish the neighbours ___ quieter.

accepted: were

hints: Regret sur un état présent, avec be.

fields.regle: « I wish I knew » dit un regret sur le présent : le verbe recule au prétérit. « I wish he wouldn't » exprime l'agacement devant une habitude.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : J'aimerais parler gallois.

accepted: I wish I spoke Welsh

hints: Regret sur le présent : prétérit.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Si seulement il arrêtait de reporter.

hints: Prétérit du regret.

accepted: did
didn't live

exercises.prompt: I cannot come, and I am sorry about it.

accepted: I wish I could come

hints: Regret sur le présent.

accepted: I wish I had more time before the board

hints: Regret sur le présent : prétérit.

exercises.prompt: I wish this lift ___ so slow.

accepted: were not

hints: Irréel du présent.

fields.regle: if + had + participe → would have + participe. I wish I had ... : regret sur le passé.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Si j'avais su, je serais venu plus tôt. »

accepted: If I had known, I would have come earlier
If I'd known, I would have come earlier

hints: Passé irréel : if + had + participe, puis would have + participe.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Je regrette de ne pas avoir accepté ce poste. »

accepted: I wish I had accepted that job
I wish I'd accepted that job

hints: Regret sur le passé : wish + had + participe.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Elle n'aurait pas raté le train si elle s'était levée à l'heure. »

accepted: She wouldn't have missed the train if she had got up on time
She would not have missed the train if she had got up on time

hints: Les deux membres se mettent au passé irréel.

exercises.prompt: If we ___ the map, we wouldn't have got lost. (bring)

accepted: had brought
'd brought

hints: Condition passée non réalisée : had + participe.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ my umbrella yesterday. (take)

accepted: had taken
'd taken

hints: Le regret porte sur hier : had + participe.

exercises.source: Théa didn't revise, so she failed the test.

accepted: If Théa had revised, she would have passed the test
If Thea had revised, she would have passed the test

hints: On inverse les faits : négatif devient positif.

exercises.source: If I would have known, I would have said something.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: If I had known, I would have said something
If I'd known, I would have said something

hints: Jamais would après if : c'est had qui porte la condition.

exercises.prompt: We ___ the ferry if we had left an hour earlier.

accepted: would have caught

hints: Résultat imaginaire d'une condition passée.

fields.regle: if + past perfect → would have : le passé qu'on ne peut plus changer. « I wish I had known » dit le regret du passé.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Si j'avais su, je ne serais pas venu.

accepted: If I had known, I would not have come

hints: Irréel du passé.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : J'aurais aimé qu'on me prévienne.

accepted: I wish somebody had told me

hints: Regret du passé.

accepted: They would have signed if the scope had been written down

hints: would have + participe.

hints: Regret sur le passé.

exercises.source: Nobody warned us, so we missed the deadline.
hints: Irréel du passé.

exercises.prompt: If I would have known, I would have said something.

accepted: If I had known, I would have said something

exercises.source: If I would have known, I would have said something.
hints: Pas de would dans la subordonnée en if.

exercises.prompt: She ___ the job if she had applied.

accepted: would have got

hints: Irréel du passé.

fields.regle: wish ... would : agacement devant ce qui ne change pas. Pour l'avenir souhaité, on emploie hope, pas wish.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « J'aimerais que tu arrêtes de m'interrompre. »

hints: Agacement devant une habitude d'autrui : wish + would.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « J'espère qu'il fera beau demain. »

accepted: I hope the weather will be nice tomorrow
I hope the weather is nice tomorrow

hints: Pour l'avenir, on emploie hope, jamais wish.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « J'aimerais que cette pluie s'arrête. »

accepted: I wish this rain would stop

hints: On souhaite un changement qui ne vient pas.

exercises.prompt: I wish they ___ playing that song. (would / stop)

accepted: would stop

hints: Le comportement dérange et se répète.

exercises.prompt: I ___ you enjoy the concert tonight. (hope)

accepted: hope

hints: Souhait tourné vers l'avenir : hope.

I wish the dog wouldn't bark all night

exercises.source: I wish you will come to the party.

I hope you come to the party

exercises.prompt: I wish my laptop ___ so slowly.

accepted: didn't start

hints: Regret sur une situation actuelle : prétérit.
